description: Named scalar constants/rates for PvE result calculations: risk, money, experience, extra-mission points and heal-point payouts.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvECalculation. Consumers construct names (RISK_VALUE_*, MONEY_*, EXPERIENCE_*, HEAL_POINT_* and mode-clear labels) or take them from PvEMission's Id_PvECalculation_* fields, then look the row up over PvECalculationDataTables (DTM+0x950). The member itself is not read as data.

Value.simple: Numeric value of the named calculation constant.
Value.technical: float, constructor default 0.0f. Used throughout PvE result computation: risk starts from RISK_VALUE_MISSION_CLEAR_VALUE and is multiplied by task-clear, previous-mission-count, evaluation and mission difficulty rows before FloorToInt; money uses the mission's money row, task/vow-count/help multipliers and win/loss vow rates before FloorToInt; experience follows the same shape from an evaluation row and the mission's experience row. Other rows supply extra-mission points, heal-point clear/task/vow increments and whole-run mode-clear bonuses (including a HealPoint x per-point bonus term). Some lookups are guarded and leave 0 when absent; others are dereferenced without a null check.

notes: The exported asset has 109 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvECalculation; the manager loads PvECalculationDataTable into PvECalculationDataTables (DTM+0x950).

Many consumers are named GamePvE_Calc* helpers in GamePhase_BattlePvESolo.cpp with retail RVAs in comments. They read constants by constructed FName or by ids copied from PvEMission rows; see PvEMission documentation for those cross-table joins.
Some result helpers return 0 for extra missions or when a row is missing, while others dereference the finder result unguarded. That asymmetry is part of the reconstructed behaviour.
Finder 0x1625810 is labelled behavioural in status/functions.json. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspected.

usages.detail: GamePvE_CalcResultRiskValue combines multiple risk constants and the mission's risk id.
GamePvE_CalcResultMoney computes mission payout from calculation rows and binding-vow state.
GamePvE_CalcResultExperience computes experience payout from evaluation and mission rows.
Extra-mission point helpers read evaluation-ranked constants.
Mode-clear money and experience helpers read whole-run bonus and heal-point bonus rows.
